<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/scenes/space"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Call this API to replace each scene's direct space associations as a whole. `spaceIds` supports multiple IDs; an empty array clears direct associations. The legacy single-space `spaceId` parameter remains compatible; only one non-null form may be provided. Batch operations return `successIds` / `failedItems` item by item. Partial success still returns code=0; all failures return code=2023, REST HTTP 400.
